definitions.failure: Entry signal breakout level crossed back by a daily close within the next 5 trading days, only while position remains held; descriptive, not a causal diagnosis.
definitions.concentration: Subtract realized profits of largest winners while holding the historical sizing path fixed; not a rerun.
definitions.efficiency20: abs(close-close20)/sum(abs(daily changes),20), observed on signal day; lower means more two-way movement, not proof of consolidation.
